craft_notes: Sthāyin: śṛṅgāra-adbhuta of inseparables; vyabhicāri love-wonder (rati-vismaya) at power never parting. Sanskrit-first: bheda-vāñchā nāsti (NO-WANT-of-difference — kept ‘wants no parting’; want denied, not parting described); vahni-dahana (FIRE-BURNING — dṛṣṭānta kept abstract). Rows: 9 (never-ever doubled — na kadācit hammered), 10 (fire/burning left standing, no gloss), 1 (‘burning’ closes — seal-image last). Close: ‘as fire is one with burning’. Rupture: em-dash (refusal turns to seal-image). Rejected: ‘like fire and its flame’ — killed: abstract kept abstract; ‘separate’ — killed: parting-want is the doctrine (want, not fact); ‘eternally united’ — killed: ‘eternally one’ kept (oneness, not union). Read aloud: POW-er WANTS no PART-ing FROM her BEAR-er — NEV-er, EV-er … the TWO are e-TERN-al-ly ONE — AS-fire IS-one WITH-burn-ING.

lines: Power wants no parting from her bearer — never, ever;
the two are eternally one — as fire is one with burning.
l4.sanskrit_cite: śaktiś ca śaktimadrūpād vyatirekam na vāñchati | tādātmyam anayor nityaṃ vahnidāhikayor iva

reads_against.argmap: Does power ever part from her bearer? → No-desire-for-difference, then eternal identity; fire-burning seals it.
c1_essence: Power refuses parting; eternal identity, fire-sealed.
